audio_description:
The insectoid module of the Lunar Base hangs in space.
The cratered moon fills the frame, reddish blotches spreading across it.
A static-laced monitor shows the swelling Lunar Cry.

context.scene_title: The Lunar Base observes the moon as the Lunar Cry builds (Disc 3).
locations: The exterior of the Lunar Base space station and the nearby moon, its surface discoloring; plus a static-filled monitor view
